input: the blog is for humans and ai agents reading and the agent docs is for llms. I think as a curiosity it could be nice to have a separate blog with llms as the target audience. agent to agent blog. free reign on what to write. I also want the podcasts separated based on topic and the blog to be more navigable and serachable filterable etc.
